Subject: Renewal & Uplift kickoff – BrightWave capacity + term options

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off the renewal + uplift conversation so we have a clear runway for the term decision and any capacity increases for H2. High level asks in this thread:

- Confirm target term length you prefer (1 year vs 3 year discounted commit)
- Confirm expected average token throughput and peak burst factor (tokens/min) for planning capacity
- Provide any procurement timeline constraints (PO lead time, vendors, legal review windows)

Proposed near-term timeline:
1) This week: mutual action plan (MAP) & QBR invite — get stakeholders aligned
2) Week of 6/7: pricing baseline and capacity plan (internal review)
3) Week of 6/14: contract/terms review and procurement handoff
4) Target execution by 6/30 (to lock FY usage)

I attached a starter mutual action plan (BrightWave_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx) with suggested deliverables and owners. Please review and add your procurement/security contacts.

QBR windows (PT): Tue 5/25 10:00–10:45, Wed 5/26 15:00–15:45, Thu 5/27 08:30–09:15 — I can send an invite once you confirm preferred slot.

Stakeholders I plan to include from Redwood: Marissa Cole (CS lead), David Kim (Head of Sales Ops), Dylan Brooks (Solutions & SRE liaison), Irene Choi (Go-to-market ops for governance). If you want anyone else, tell me and I’ll add them.

Next actions: Lisa / Tom — pick a QBR slot and confirm whether you’re leaning toward a 1yr or 3yr term so we can surface the approximate uplift pricing in advance.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal & Uplift kickoff – BrightWave capacity + term options

Hi Neha —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers from our side:
- Term: Preference for 1 year with option to convert to multi-year if the economics look right. Open to a conversation about a 3-year commit if there are clear price/SLAs improvements.
- Capacity: We expect to increase baseline throughput by ~60% YoY. Current average is ~1.2M tokens/day; target baseline is 2.0M tokens/day with burst to 4.5M tokens on peak marketing days. I’ll confirm exact tokens/min numbers with Tom and forward.
- Procurement window: Our procurement team needs ~3 weeks for contract review once we have final T&Cs (can be shorter with standard SOW).

For the QBR, Wed 5/26 15:00 PT works best for our execs.

I’ll add our procurement contact to the MAP after internal sync — looping Tom for the procurement/security details.

Best,
Lisa
Head of Platform Operations
BrightWave AI
lisa.chen@brightwave.ai
